hypotheses.title: Navigation to the 'About' page

Click on the 'About' link in the navigation bar.

observed.result: The user is directed to a page with detailed information about the devamir storefront demo, but there are no visible sections or content related to the 'About' section's expected content.

After devamir, no structured interface change was observed despite the recorded expectation: Navigates to the homepage.
After Shop, no structured interface change was observed despite the recorded expectation: Navigating to the shopping section of the website.

expected.result: The user should see a detailed description of devamir, its mission, and features related to the storefront demo.

After devamir, no structured interface change was observed despite the recorded expectation: Navigates to the homepage.
After Shop, no structured interface change was observed despite the recorded expectation: Navigating to the shopping section of the website.

expected.result: The user should be directed to a search results page or a product selection page where they can view and interact with the search results.
expected.justification: Based on project documentation, clicking 'Browse collection' is expected to lead users to a page where they can browse products. The absence of any search functionality suggests an issue in how this feature is implemented.

limitations: A retained item is a hypothesis, not a confirmed application defect.
Expected behavior may be inferred from documentation, cross-state consistency, interface conventions, or model judgment.
States not reached during model-guided exploration were not evaluated.
Visual and semantic model judgments can be wrong even when their evidence references are valid.
